message.content: For my dinner party, I would invite Leonardo da Vinci, Marie Curie, and Martin Luther King Jr. These individuals, from vastly different eras, embody the pursuit of excellence, knowledge, and equality. Engaging them would allow for a rich conversation about how creativity and ethical leadership can drive societal progress. It’s a unique assembly to appreciate the enduring power of human intellect and spirit.
